findings.issue: The body passes MarkdownText a freshly built labels object on every render: labels={markdownLabels()} (plan-view.js:100), and markdownLabels() (plan-view.js:53) returns a new literal each call. MarkdownText is memoized on that prop, so each copy click, and each 1200 ms/2000 ms status flip, re-renders and re-parses the whole plan document. Not user-visible for a normal-size plan, but it is a documented contract of the component the change adds.

DSH's own plan preview does exactly that: dsh-client-ui-plan/lib/client.js:183-194 builds labels inside useMemo keyed on the translator. No requirement covers render cost, so no requirement id.
